content: We conducted a comprehensive comparison with the baseline models, and some of them were never investigated for the abbreviation disambiguation task. We applied traditional features by simply taking the TF-IDF features as the inputs into the classic classifiers. Deep features are also considered: a Doc2vec model BIBREF19 was pre-trained using Gensim and these word embeddings were applied to initialize deep models and fine-tuned.
